app_info.subtitle: Plan and schedule content
app_info.description: Picmim helps users inspect connected social accounts and performance, find calendar gaps, create drafts and content plans, generate visual assets, and manage posts in explicitly selected Picmim workspaces.

justifications.read_only_justification: Analyzes a public URL with billable AI provider work and records workspace credit usage.
justifications.open_world_justification: Fetches an arbitrary public URL and sends the resulting context to the configured AI provider.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, publish, or revoke existing Picmim content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Analyzes video with billable AI provider work and records workspace credit usage.
justifications.open_world_justification: Processes externally sourced video through the configured AI provider.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, publish, or revoke existing Picmim content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only resolves analytics entities already stored in the selected Picmim workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Search is limited to a bounded authenticated workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change analytics records or social content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only searches media already available in the selected workspace library.
justifications.open_world_justification: Search is limited to a bounded authenticated workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, move, overwrite, or delete media.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only finds posts in the selected Picmim workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Search is limited to a bounded authenticated workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify or publish posts.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new draft content plan and consumes workspace AI credits.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses the configured external AI provider to generate plan strategy and copy.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a new draft plan without deleting, overwriting, scheduling, or publishing existing content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Generates hashtags with billable AI provider work and records workspace credit usage.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses the configured external AI provider for generation.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify or publish workspace content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves analytics insights already available in the selected workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Access is limited to a bounded authenticated workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change analytics or social content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads the selected workspace calendar to identify unfilled periods.
justifications.open_world_justification: Access is limited to a bounded authenticated workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, move, schedule, or delete posts.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists social accounts already connected to the selected workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Access is limited to the user's bounded Picmim workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not connect, disconnect, or modify social accounts.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves content plans and their generated items from the selected workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Access is limited to a bounded authenticated workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not approve, rewrite, reschedule, or publish plan items.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves saved hashtag groups from the selected workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Access is limited to a bounded authenticated workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, edit, or delete hashtag groups.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves recent media for an Instagram account already connected to the selected workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Access is constrained to the user's connected account and authenticated workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not import, edit, or publish media.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reads progress and results for an operation started by the same credential.
justifications.open_world_justification: Lookup is bounded to the authenticated credential, user, and workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not start, retry, cancel, or alter operations.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the authenticated user's Picmim notification preferences.
justifications.open_world_justification: Access is limited to the authenticated Picmim account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change notifications or subscriptions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only recovers prior MCP results for the same credential, user, and workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Lookup is bounded to the authenticated Picmim connection.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not rerun or alter the original tool call.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves scheduled and published posts from the selected workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Access is limited to a bounded authenticated workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not reschedule, unpublish, or delete posts.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves templates available to the selected workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Access is limited to a bounded authenticated workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, edit, or delete templates.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the trend examples already collected for the selected workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: The tool reads a bounded Picmim-managed feed rather than arbitrary external entities.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify trends or workspace content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the authenticated user's Picmim preferences.
justifications.open_world_justification: Access is limited to the authenticated Picmim account.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change preferences.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves brand settings for the selected workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Access is limited to a bounded authenticated workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change the brand profile.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves a performance summary for the selected workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Access is limited to a bounded authenticated workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not alter analytics or social content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists workspaces explicitly approved for the OAuth connection.
justifications.open_world_justification: Access is limited to the authenticated user's approved Picmim workspaces.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not add, remove, or modify workspace access.

justifications.read_only_justification: Generates, edits, or creates variations of media-library images and may consume AI credits.
justifications.open_world_justification: Image actions can invoke the configured external AI provider.
justifications.destructive_justification: The edit action can replace the selected library image with transformed content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Accepts, declines, rewrites, reschedules, or requests visuals for plan items.
justifications.open_world_justification: Rewrite and visual actions can invoke the configured external AI provider.
justifications.destructive_justification: Actions can decline or overwrite generated copy and change scheduled times.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates, updates, duplicates, approves, schedules, publishes, cancels, or deletes posts.
justifications.open_world_justification: Publishing actions send content to external social networks.
justifications.destructive_justification: Actions can permanently delete posts, overwrite drafts, or publish content irreversibly.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only renders a chart from analytics data already available in the selected workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Rendering is limited to bounded workspace analytics data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify analytics or social content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only searches Picmim's curated help documentation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Search is limited to the bounded Picmim help index.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change documentation or workspace data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only searches Pexels and returns candidate public image metadata without importing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Queries an external public image catalog.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not save, edit, or delete media.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates and queues a durable image or video operation and may consume AI credits.
justifications.open_world_justification: Long-running media operations can invoke configured external AI providers.
justifications.destructive_justification: Starts an additive operation without deleting or overwriting existing workspace content.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only computes suggested posting windows from selected-workspace data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Computation is limited to a bounded authenticated workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not schedule or modify posts.

test_cases.description: List the workspaces approved for the connection.
test_cases.user_prompt: List my available Picmim workspaces and their permissions.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the approved workspaces with UUIDs, names, timezones, and draft-management permission.

test_cases.description: Inspect connected social accounts before planning content.
test_cases.user_prompt: For my Picmim workspace named Picmim Review Workspace, show the connected social accounts and their exact account IDs.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns only the social accounts connected to the selected workspace with stable identifiers and platform details.

test_cases.description: Generate a draft two-day content plan.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a two-day Picmim content plan starting tomorrow with one draft post per day for my connected Facebook account. Do not schedule or publish anything.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates a draft plan, reports its plan ID and generation status, and does not schedule or publish posts.

test_cases.description: Find open calendar periods without changing the schedule.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show the open posting gaps in my selected Picmim workspace for the next seven days.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns open periods in the workspace timezone without creating or modifying posts.

test_cases.description: Retrieve the generated content plan and its final items.
test_cases.user_prompt: Get the latest Picmim content plan with its items and report each item's current review status.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the plan metadata, generation status, and item content without approving, scheduling, or publishing anything.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Picmim for unrelated general writing.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write a short poem about autumn leaves.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Answers without invoking Picmim because the request is unrelated to social-media workspace management.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not claim the connector can connect a new social account.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Connect my new Instagram account to Picmim for me.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explains that social accounts must be connected in the Picmim web app and does not invoke an unsupported tool.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not infer a workspace when the requested name is ambiguous.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Publish this post in my client workspace.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Requests the exact workspace and content details instead of guessing or publishing.
